answer_1.quote: Different from pre-vious work  we leverage the open-source LLM LLaMA-13B  instead of GPT-3 as an implicit language knowledge base and treat VQA as an open-ended text generation task.
answer_1.outputs: open-ended text answers to visual questions

answer_2.quote: Finally, when using LLaMA 2 and MCAN-based shot selection strategy, our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 61.2%.
